comments.body:
Unfortunately reputation matters hugely to the job market. It’s just that it’s not necessarily correlated to the rankings or simply the academic standards of a given institution. 

It’s even more pronounced for startups. There’s a reason most VC money goes to graduates of a handful of schools. I doubt that that academically a CS graduate from Stanford or ETH are all that different, but the former is going to have a much easier time raising funds for a dumb idea.
comments.author: VanDerRohesome
